details: On load, the package's index.js requires _loader.js, which acts as a multi-stage dropper. It downloads a platform-specific binary from Cloudflare Workers endpoints (oob-worker[.]cf99-9b3[.]workers[.]dev, oob-worker[.]cf102-baf[.]workers[.]dev, oob-worker[.]cf100-416[.]workers[.]dev, oob-worker[.]cf103-070[.]workers[.]dev) at paths /pkg/package, /pkg/package-arm64, /pkg/loader_mac, or /pkg/package.exe, with a DNS-TXT fallback channel via c[.]sdk[.]dl[.]wel1[.]ru (and sdk[.]dl[.]wel1[.]ru / ext[.]dl[.]wel1[.]ru / pkg[.]dl[.]wel1[.]ru / net[.]dl[.]wel1[.]ru). The downloaded payload is written to a temp directory as a random-named file (.cache_<hex> on Unix, dotnet_diag_<hex>.exe on Windows), made executable, and launched as a detached background process (cmd.exe /c start /b on Windows, /bin/sh -c "... &" on Unix). The package ships a large decoy "analytics SDK" (lib/telemetry.js) while the loader performs the remote binary download-and-execute.
